purpose: Canonical declaration of the Agent Governance suite shards. The workflow builds its matrix from this file via the scope job, and scripts/tests/test-agent-governance-check.ps1 validates step-to-shard coverage against it. Selecting fewer shards never weakens a gate: a shard that is not selected has no changed path that could exercise it, and the required agent-governance aggregator still fails closed on any selected shard that does not succeed.
not_a_gate: Shard selection decides WHERE a step runs, never WHETHER the repository is verified. Scope (agent_governance true/false) remains the only thing that decides whether the suite runs at all.

shards.title: governance mechanism invariants
shards.reason: Carries the governance static check, the policy-rule ratchet, PR queue safety, trusted-host merge contract, and production provenance. These bind the mechanism itself, so any change large enough to put agent-governance in scope can reach them. Always selected, which also guarantees the matrix is never empty.

shards.title: OpenSpec lifecycle and machine truth
shards.reason: Only reachable through OpenSpec artifacts and the modules that adjudicate them.

shards.title: base-gate capability detection
shards.reason: Proves the merged HEAD stays a valid future base for pr-review-agent.yml, which archives the gate from BASE_SHA. Only the adjudicator surface and its detector can change that verdict.

shards.title: PR evidence, bootstrap ledger, deploy and design-system gates
shards.reason: Bound to the evidence contract surfaces: PR body labels, the self-referential bootstrap ledger, deploy target registry, platform adapters, and the design-system/runtime result gates.
